name: @repid/protocol
description: RepID protocol constants and normative specs (SPEC-005 indexer, SPEC-007 confidence index, SPEC-008 normative core, SPEC-009 wire format). Vendored into the cash-freelancers monorepo from the reference implementation; kept byte-identical to upstream so it can be diffed against it. NOTE: the `@repid` scope here is deliberate and differs from the `@cash-freelancers` scope used by this repo's own packages, to preserve provenance.
